We are building the energy and infrastructure future—today. Come join us in accelerating the energy and infrastructure transition! jobs.title: Legal Operations and Contracts Specialist
jobs.description: Who We Are Nomi Health is rebuilding healthcare with services and technology solutions designed to make access to quality, affordable care simpler and more direct. We connect buyers, providers, and patients through an operating model focused on reducing complexity, improving transparency, and removing unnecessary cost from the healthcare system. The Impact You’ll Make We're hiring an early-career Legal Operations and Contracts Specialist to help keep our legal function running smoothly. We’re looking for someone who takes real ownership. You bring deep, hands-on SOX expertise, a track record of delivering projects reliably, and the confidence to run with complex work independently. If you take pride in being the person others count on to get it done right, we’d love to meet you. This is a remote position open to candidates based in Canada. jobs.description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. How you'll make impact As Corporate Counsel, you’ll support Airwallex’s growth in the UK by providing practical, business-focused legal advice on corporate, regulatory and commercial matters. You’ll also advise on marketing, referral and partnership initiatives, helping the business move quickly while managing legal and regulatory risk. Provide clear, pragmatic advice on UK and relevant EMEA legal and regulatory requirements, helping teams navigate applicable rules while enabling responsible growth. jobs.title: Senior Legal Partner
jobs.description: About the Role A Germany-based, AI-enabled legal services firm is seeking a senior partner to help grow its practice and shape how technology supports legal work. You will bring an established client portfolio, continue advising those clients, and work with the founding team to develop a scalable model for commercial and compliance services. What You'll Do Help shape the firm's growth and expand its client relationships. Bring a portable client portfolio to the firm's technology platform while continuing to serve existing clients. Build market credibility and develop opportunities through your professional network, including private equity and venture capital contacts. Identify opportunities to provide commercial and compliance services across your client base. Work with the founding team to identify recurring legal matters that can be streamlined through AI and automation. What We're Looking For 12 to 20 or more years of German legal practice, with experience at partner level. German-qualified Volljurist and admitted Rechtsanwalt, with native-level German and professional English. A personally held, portable book of business valued at €1 million or more, with a diversified client base and strong private equity or venture capital relationships. Experience in recurring, automatable work such as commercial contracts, IT and data, corporate or venture capital, or regulatory matters. Practical experience using AI tools, such as OpenAI-based tools, and a willingness to adapt legal workflows through automation. A realistic client transition path and no restrictions that would prevent bringing client relationships to a new practice. Compensation & Benefits Base salary range: €200,000 to €300,000 annually. Meaningful equity is available. Visa sponsorship is not available. Location Based in Berlin, Germany. The role is primarily remote, with in-person work in Berlin preferred; remote arrangements are considered for exceptional candidates. Compensation: €200K – €300K • €200K

jobs.description: At Vio , we believe booking accommodation should feel fair and effortless, never overwhelming or unclear. As one of the world’s fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites so that they can find the best place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. Our goal is to help travelers book like an insider. That means cutting through the noise and complexity of hotel booking and surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays, booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology that travelers can trust. Who we’re looking for We are looking for an experienced Founding Legal Counsel to help us build Vio's legal function from the ground up – owning our commercial contracts, managing legal risk across the business and getting us ready for our next stage of growth. This is Vio's first in-house legal role. You'll be our go-to person for all things legal: a commercial lawyer first and foremost and the owner of our full legal portfolio. You won't need to be an expert in every area, but you'll know when to answer yourself and when to orchestrate external support. Reporting into our COO, you’ll become a trusted business partner to our leadership team and decision makers across Vio, pragmatically solving any problems and helping us think creatively about how we manage and mitigate our risk. jobs.description: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk adalah sebuah badan usaha milik negara Indonesia yang menyediakan berbagai macam jasa keuangan. Bank yang berkantor pusat di Jakarta ini adalah salah satu bank terbesar di Indonesia dalam hal jumlah aset, pinjaman, dan simpanannya. Bank Mandiri didirikan pada 2 Oktober 1998, sebagai bagian dari program restrukturisasi perbankan yang dilaksanakan oleh pemerintah Indonesia. Pada bulan Juli 1999, empat bank pemerintah yaitu Bank Bumi Daya, Bank Dagang Negara, Bank Ekspor Impor Indonesia dan Bank Pembangunan Indonesia dilebur menjadi Bank Mandiri, dimana masing-masing bank tersebut memiliki peran yang tak terpisahkan dalam pembangunan perekonomian Indonesia. Sampai dengan hari ini, Bank Mandiri meneruskan tradisi selama lebih dari 140 tahun memberikan kontribusi dalam dunia perbankan dan perekonomian Indonesia.
